_meta.name: real_fillers_mcguffey_wordnet_v1
_meta.source: McGuffey gold argstruct + castle SVO (data/gold_mcguffey_lccp_argstruct_v1.json, data/gold_mcguffey_castle_building_svo_v1.json); real fillers = WordNet(nltk) hypernym-closure feature vectors (dominant + up to 3 senses) with idf weights; role_group from attested corpus roles (pronoun agents resolved to content ref head).
_meta.credit: WordNet (Fellbaum 1998) via nltk; McGuffey Third Reader PG#14766 (public domain).
_meta.note: feature vectors -> deterministic FHRR phasor codes in the cell (angle of idf-weighted sum of per-feature random phasors). N is NOT a de-sat knob (angle-only geometry); additive noise is the erosion knob.
